'''Trianii Space''',  also referred to as the '''Trianii Colonies''', was a [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsector]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] inhabited by the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trian/Legends|Trian]], while [[Brochiib]], [[Ekibo]], [[Fibuli]], [[Pypin]] were collectively known as the Trianii Colonies.

==Geography==
The Trianii Space was a [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsector]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], rimward of the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo]] and [[Farana (region)/Legends|Farana sectors]], between the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was also near the [[Kobothi Space]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==History==
The Trianii Space was the region containing the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Trian/Legends|Trian]], and their colonies. The region was a regional rival of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] offered to annex it but the Trianii always refused. The CSA attempted to forcefully [[CSA–Trianii War|subjugate]] several [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] colonies, but met resistance from the [[Trianii Rangers]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Trianii Space had become a [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsector]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="EAOC" /> This meant that this remote area was poorly explored or insufficiently documented before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial period]] and was only recognized as a potential sector by the Empire. Yet, the region was not given a formal sector status when incorporated into [[Imperial Space]] and was not represented in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] for the time being.<ref name="TEA" />

The region was annexed by [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and stayed in [[Zsinj's Empire|his territory]] until [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|his death]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
